text:
Maria Gomez: Heads-up: I opened a docs PR that bundles a migration guide for the v1->v2 API plus a short deprecation notice pattern for embedded examples. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5021. Need review from eng and SDK owners for the fallback examples.
Sanjeev Patel: skimmed the guide. Nice flow. Two questions: 1) do we show both streaming and non-streaming examples for the SDKs? 2) how do we recommend customers surface errors when a model swap falls back to v1?
Maria Gomez: I included both styles for JS and Python. For error-surface we recommend exposing a small header `x-rw-model-fallback: v1` and logging the `model_variant` field in telemetry.
Priya Nair: SDK owners: I pushed companion PRs to update snippets: https://github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/387 and https://github.com/redwood-inference/python-sdk/pull/401. The JS streaming example needed a tiny API change (new `onPartial` callback signature).
Oliver King: We need to be careful with ephemeral snippet tokens in the examples. I replaced the long keys with `REDACTED_KEY` and added a note about scoped API keys for demos.
Maria Gomez: good call. I also added a short troubleshooting appendix that lists observed regressions (tokenization differences, streaming chunk boundaries) and suggested mitigations (pin alias, fall back with smaller context).
Priya Nair: CI please run the snippet verifier and the internal link-checker? @BuildBot
BuildBot: Running: docs-snippet-checker/5021 and link-check/5021. Snippet checker: found one failing Go example (wrong import path). Link-check: two broken anchors.
Maria Gomez: thanks BuildBot. Fixed the Go import and adjusted the anchors. Pushed new commit.
Sanjeev Patel: small editorial change: in the deprecation banner we should say "Planned removal: 30 days after notice" only on the high-impact pages. Also add a quick two-sentence FAQ "What if my app needs v1-only behavior?"
Maria Gomez: updated banners and added FAQ. I also added a short Cloudflare Worker redirect sample for customers who can't touch origin:
```
addEventListener('fetch', event => {
  const url = new URL(event.request.url);
  if (url.pathname.startsWith('/api/v1/')) {
    return event.respondWith(Response.redirect(url.pathname.replace('/api/v1/', '/api/v2/'), 302));
  }
  return event.respondWith(fetch(event.request));
});
```
Priya Nair: linking the two SDK PRs from the doc PR saved a lot. Can we add a line in the guide showing how to run a local smoke test: `python -m pytest tests/snippets` and `npm run test:snippets`?
Maria Gomez: added a CI job snippet and a short `yarn docs:smoke` command. Asking for a final thumbs from @Sanjeev and @Oliver so we can schedule landing in tomorrow's docs deploy window (11:00 UTC).
BuildBot: docs-snippet-checker/5021: passed. link-check/5021: passed.
Sanjeev Patel: approved after CI green. Left an inline about phrasing.
Oliver King: approved. Left a tiny copy edit.
DocsBot: Automated: docs linter OK. Reminder: add `deprecation` tag to frontmatter for all affected pages so search filters pick them up.
Maria Gomez: anchored that and will add a changelog blurb for Customer Success. Thanks all.
